title.narrative: La population burundaise, en particulier les jeunes, les femmes et les autres groupes vulnérables ont accès à plus d'opportunités d'emplois décents et durables dans un contexte de consolidation de la paix et de croissance économique

description.narrative:
This Country Programme Outcome seeks to empower the Burundian population, particularly youth, women, and other vulnerable groups, by creating decent and sustainable employment opportunities. It addresses persistent gaps in skills and labour market demands by strengthening labour market systems, promoting economic diversification, and integrating green jobs into workforce development strategies.
The programme aligns closely with Burundi’s National Development Plan, focusing on revitalizing key sectors like agriculture and services while fostering social inclusion and gender equity. Beneficiaries include youth, women, and marginalized communities, with implementation driven by the Burundian government, private sector stakeholders, and social partners in collaboration with the ILO and international development agencies.
Expected outcomes include improved access to employment, enhanced sectoral collaboration, and strengthened institutional capacities to sustain and expand employment promotion initiatives.
